C api007.unexpected-propagate OL API-007 DEFAULT ;; Programming defects and unexpected database/external failures the application cannot handle locally propagate to the global exception handler. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api021.request-aborted OL API-021 MUST_NOT ;; Treat client-aborted requests (RequestAborted cancellation) separately: neither an unhandled application error nor a 500. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api008.dev-diagnostics OL API-008 MUST ;; Development tooling may expose more diagnostics but public API contracts stay safe. ;; = ;; Development diagnostics. ;;
C api009.result-reserved OL API-009,ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Use an explicit typed outcome where clearer; adopting a project-wide Result pattern is Reserved and, if adopted, used consistently. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.eh-result-typed-errors EX API-009 PREFER ;; If a Result pattern is adopted, use typed errors rather than arbitrary strings passed through every layer. ;; = ;; Only when a Result pattern is adopted. ;; Oracle leaves the Result shape open; typed errors is an added design preference.
C x.eh-validation-invocation EX API-010,DEP-010 MUST ;; Register validators via AddValidatorsFromAssemblyContaining and follow the project's established validation invocation pattern rather than adding a second competing mechanism. ;; = ;; none ;; Single-invocation-mechanism rule not entailed by API-010/DEP-010.
C api010.not-replace-business OL API-010,ARC-003 MUST ;; API validation does not replace business rules; CRUD/workflow/orchestration rules stay in Application unless an approved richer Domain design. ;; = ;; Approved richer Domain design. ;;
C api011.typed-exceptions-decision OL API-011 MUST ;; Typed exceptions for selected cases only as a consistent project-level decision, not a per-feature habit. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api007.no-swallow OL API-007,RUN-018 MUST_NOT ;; Do not catch Exception simply to continue execution. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api012.no-log-rethrow OL API-012,API-007 MUST_NOT ;; Do not write catch/log/rethrow boilerplate at every layer when the global handler owns it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api002.no-anonymous-errors OL API-002 AVOID ;; Avoid returning inconsistent anonymous error objects. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc010.no-minimal-filters OL ARC-010 AVOID ;; Avoid coupling validation to Minimal API endpoint filters in a Controller-based project. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api010.not-only-validators OL API-010 AVOID ;; Avoid putting business rules only in request validators. ;; = ;; none ;;

168-170 MX [sec001.no-hardcoded-keys,x.auth-policy-constants,gov013.no-speculative-identity] ;; Hardcoded signing keys (SEC-001) and identity infrastructure without need (GOV-013) are oracle; scattered role/permission magic strings is the added constants rule.

C x.auth-prefer-policies EX SEC-005 PREFER ;; Prefer policy-based authorization when logic is more than a trivial role check. ;; = ;; none ;; Authorization-mechanism preference not in the oracle.
C x.auth-scheme-choice EX SEC-016,ARC-020 DEFAULT ;; Choose the authentication scheme from the actual application: Bearer/OIDC for SPA→API, cookies for server-rendered apps, ASP.NET Core Identity when owning local users/passwords, external OIDC/OAuth when identity is delegated. ;; = ;; none ;; Scheme-selection mapping is candidate guidance; the oracle only requires platform mechanisms and approval for auth architecture.
C gov013.no-speculative-identity OL GOV-013,SEC-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add ASP.NET Core Identity merely because a User entity or profile management exists; do not add Identity, JWT issuance or OIDC infrastructure without actual need. ;; = ;; Identity when the app owns local accounts and needs its account management. ;;
C sec016.no-custom-jwt OL SEC-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not issue custom JWTs when an existing identity provider owns token issuance. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec016.framework-passwords OL SEC-016,SEC-001 MUST ;; When the app owns passwords use framework hashing, lockout and reset-token features; never store plaintext passwords or auth secrets in source. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec017.actual-issuer OL SEC-017 MUST ;; Configure Bearer validation for the issuer that actually issues the tokens; keys/certificates follow configuration and security rules. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec006.explicit-approach OL SEC-006 MUST ;; Secure endpoints via global/fallback policy, attributes or endpoint configuration and keep the chosen approach explicit and reviewable. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec006.fallback-allowanonymous OL SEC-006 MUST ;; With a secure global/fallback policy repeated [Authorize] is unnecessary; mark deliberate public endpoints with [AllowAnonymous]. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.auth-policy-constants EX - DEFAULT ;; Use stable constants for repeated policy names; avoid role/permission magic strings scattered through the codebase. ;; = ;; none ;; Code-hygiene convention not in the oracle.
C x.auth-roles EX SEC-005 PREFER ;; Use roles only for genuinely role-oriented models; avoid scattered compound role strings; prefer a policy when several roles/claims represent one capability. ;; = ;; none ;; Authorization-modelling preference not in the oracle.
C sec005.resource-authz OL SEC-005 MUST ;; Resource-dependent permissions use ASP.NET Core resource authorization or explicit Application authorization logic (server-side). ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc008.current-user-abstraction OL ARC-008,ARC-007 MUST ;; When use cases repeatedly need caller identity define a small Application abstraction with an outer HTTP adapter; Application never depends on HttpContext, ClaimsPrincipal or IHttpContextAccessor. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov012.no-needless-icurrentuser OL GOV-012 MUST_NOT ;; Do not create ICurrentUser when passing an explicit user identifier is simpler. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.auth-testing EX TST-003,SEC-005 DEFAULT ;; Test authorization behaviour of important protected operations: unauthenticated→401, unauthorized→403, permitted success, ownership rules, intended anonymous access. ;; = ;; none ;; Specific security test obligations not entailed by the oracle testing policies.
C tst003.observable-auth OL TST-003 MUST ;; Verify observable authorization behaviour, not merely the presence of [Authorize]. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec001.no-hardcoded-keys OL SEC-001 AVOID ;; Avoid hardcoded signing keys. ;; = ;; none ;;
